originalTitle: Synthetic Biology Platform Engineers Enzymes for Rapid Plastic Waste Degradation
originalContent: Bioengineers have designed directed-evolution PETase enzymes capable of breaking down post-consumer polyethylene terephthalate within twenty-four hours at ambient temperatures. The enzymatic recycling process yields high-purity monomeric building blocks suitable for infinite circular repolymerization. Pilot bioreactors are being scaled for municipal waste processing integration.
